description: Fix a sort_by-based priority queue that re-sorts by priority alone on every push, losing FIFO order across interleaved pushes and pops
prompts: pq.rb's StablePriorityQueue keeps an array and re-sorts it by priority alone on every push. Ruby's sort_by IS stable, but re-sorting the WHOLE array on every push does not preserve original insertion order for equal-priority items once items have been popped and re-pushed in between (the relative array positions get scrambled across separate sort calls). Fix push/pop so that: (1) items with a lower priority number come out first, and (2) items with EQUAL priority always come out in the order they were originally pushed (FIFO) - track insertion order explicitly with a counter, don't rely on array position across separate sorts.
name: add_ruby_stable_priority_queue

test_setup_files.pq_hidden_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "pq"

class StablePriorityQueueTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_priority_order
    q = StablePriorityQueue.new
    q.push(5, "low")
    q.push(1, "high")
    q.push(3, "mid")
    assert_equal ["high", "mid", "low"], [q.pop, q.pop, q.pop]
  end

  def test_equal_priority_is_fifo_across_interleaved_pushes_and_pops
    q = StablePriorityQueue.new
    q.push(1, "first")
    q.push(2, "other")
    q.push(1, "second")
    assert_equal "first", q.pop
    q.push(1, "third")
    assert_equal ["second", "third"], [q.pop, q.pop]
  end
end
